sql:
WITH frpm_calc AS (
  SELECT
    f.CDSCode,
    f."School Name",
    f."Charter School (Y/N)" AS charter,
    f."Low Grade" AS low_grade,
    f."High Grade" AS high_grade,
    f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 1.0 / f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS free_meal_rate
  FROM frpm f
  WHERE f."County Name" = 'Alameda'
    AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0
),
county_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(free_meal_rate) AS avg_rate FROM frpm_calc
),
top_school AS (
  SELECT * FROM frpm_calc ORDER BY free_meal_rate DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  t."School Name",
  t.charter,
  t.low_grade,
  t.high_grade,
  CASE
    WHEN s.NumTstTakr IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data'
    WHEN (s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite) < 1200 THEN 'Below Average'
    WHEN (s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite) <= 1500 THEN 'Average'
    ELSE 'Above Average'
  END AS sat_performance,
  t.free_meal_rate - c.avg_rate AS deviation_from_county_avg
FROM top_school t
CROSS JOIN county_avg c
LEFT JOIN satscores s ON s.cds = SUBSTR(t.CDSCode, 1, 7) || '0000000'

sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    s.School AS school_name,
    s.Street AS street,
    s.City AS city,
    s.Zip AS zip,
    s.OpenDate AS open_date,
    CASE WHEN s.StatusType = 'Active' THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Closed' END AS status,
    f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment_k12,
    f."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS frpm_count_k12,
    f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS frpm_rate,
    sa.NumTstTakr AS num_test_takers,
    sa.AvgScrRead AS avg_read,
    sa.AvgScrMath AS avg_math,
    sa.AvgScrWrite AS avg_write,
    sa.NumGE1500 AS num_ge1500,
    CASE
      WHEN f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 0.75 THEN 'High FRPM'
      WHEN f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" >= 0.50 THEN 'Medium FRPM'
      ELSE 'Low FRPM'
    END AS frpm_level
  FROM schools s
  JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
  LEFT JOIN satscores sa ON sa.cds = s.CDSCode
  WHERE s.District = 'Fresno County Office of Education'
    AND s.Charter = 1
)
SELECT
  school_name,
  street,
  city,
  zip,
  open_date,
  status,
  enrollment_k12,
  frpm_count_k12,
  frpm_rate,
  num_test_takers,
  avg_read,
  avg_math,
  avg_write,
  num_ge1500,
  frpm_level,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY frpm_rate DESC) AS frpm_rank
FROM base
ORDER BY frpm_rate DESC

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    f."School Name" AS school_name,

    f."Educational Option Type" AS educational_option_type,
    f."Low Grade" AS low_grade,

    f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment_k12,
    f."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS frpm_count_k12,
    f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS pct_frpm,
    s.Street AS street,
    s.City AS city,
    s.Zip AS zip,
    s.MailStreet AS mail_street,
    s.MailCity AS mail_city,
    s.MailZip AS mail_zip,
    s.Website AS website,
    sat.NumTstTakr AS num_test_takers,
    sat.AvgScrRead AS avg_read,
    sat.AvgScrMath AS avg_math,
    sat.AvgScrWrite AS avg_write,
    sat.NumGE1500 AS num_ge1500,
    CAST(sat.NumGE1500 AS REAL) * 100 / sat.NumTstTakr AS pct_ge1500
  FROM frpm f
  JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
  JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = SUBSTR(f.CDSCode, 1, 7) || '0000000'
  WHERE f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 0
    AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 100
)

  school_name,
  county,
  district,
  school_type,
  educational_option_type,
  low_grade,
  high_grade,
  street,
  city,
  zip,
  mail_street,
  mail_city,
  mail_zip,
  website,
  enrollment_k12,
  frpm_count_k12,
  pct_frpm,
  num_test_takers,
  avg_read,
  avg_math,
  avg_write,
  num_ge1500,
  pct_ge1500,
  CASE
    WHEN pct_frpm > 0.70 AND pct_ge1500 > 20 THEN 'High-performing despite high FRPM'
    WHEN pct_frpm < 0.30 AND pct_ge1500 < 10 THEN 'Low-performing despite low FRPM'
    ELSE 'Typical'
  END AS performance_flag
FROM base
ORDER BY frpm_count_k12 DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH sat AS (
  SELECT s.CDSCode, s.School, s.City, s.District, s.County,
         f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS Enrollment,
         sc.NumTstTakr, sc.AvgScrRead, sc.AvgScrMath, sc.AvgScrWrite,
         (sc.AvgScrRead + sc.AvgScrMath + sc.AvgScrWrite) AS TotalSAT,

         f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS FRPMPct
  FROM schools s
  JOIN satscores sc ON sc.cds = s.CDSCode
  LEFT JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
  WHERE s.Virtual = 'F'
    AND sc.AvgScrMath > 400
)

       Enrollment,
       NumTstTakr, AvgScrRead, AvgScrMath, AvgScrWrite, TotalSAT,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY TotalSAT DESC) AS SATRank,
       FRPMCount, FRPMPct,
       CASE
         WHEN FRPMPct >= 0.75 THEN 'High Poverty'
         WHEN FRPMPct >= 0.50 THEN 'Medium Poverty'
         ELSE 'Low Poverty'
       END AS PovertyLevel
FROM sat
ORDER BY TotalSAT DESC

sql:
WITH perf AS (
  SELECT s.School AS school_name,
         s.City AS city,
         s.Magnet AS magnet,
         sa.NumTstTakr AS num_test_takers,
         sa.AvgScrRead AS avg_read,
         sa.AvgScrMath AS avg_math,
         sa.AvgScrWrite AS avg_write,
         (sa.AvgScrRead + sa.AvgScrMath + sa.AvgScrWrite) AS total_avg_sat,
         f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS frpm_pct,
         CASE
           WHEN f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" < 0.25 THEN 'Low'
           WHEN f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" < 0.50 THEN 'Moderate'
           WHEN f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" < 0.75 THEN 'High'
           ELSE 'Very High'
         END AS poverty_level,
         CASE
           WHEN (sa.AvgScrRead + sa.AvgScrMath + sa.AvgScrWrite) >= 1500 THEN 'Excellent'
           WHEN (sa.AvgScrRead + sa.AvgScrMath + sa.AvgScrWrite) >= 1200 THEN 'Good'
           WHEN (sa.AvgScrRead + sa.AvgScrMath + sa.AvgScrWrite) >= 900 THEN 'Average'
           ELSE 'Below Average'
         END AS performance_category
  FROM schools s
  JOIN satscores sa ON sa.cds = s.CDSCode
  JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
  WHERE s.Magnet = 1
    AND sa.NumTstTakr > 500
)
SELECT school_name,
       city,
       num_test_takers,
       avg_read,
       avg_math,
       avg_write,
       total_avg_sat,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_avg_sat DESC) AS sat_rank,
       frpm_pct,
       poverty_level,
       performance_category
FROM perf
ORDER BY total_avg_sat DESC

sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    f."CDSCode" AS CDSCode,
    f."County Name" AS county,
    f."School Name" AS school,
    f."Enrollment (K-12)" + f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS total_enrollment,
    f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" AS free_meal_count,
    f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" AS free_rate,
    f."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS frpm_count,
    f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS frpm_rate,
    f."Charter School (Y/N)" AS charter,
    s."NumTstTakr" AS num_test_takers,
    s."AvgScrRead" + s."AvgScrMath" + s."AvgScrWrite" AS total_sat_score,
    s."NumGE1500" AS num_ge1500
  FROM frpm f
  JOIN satscores s ON s.cds = SUBSTR(f."CDSCode", 1, 7) || '0000000'
  WHERE f."Enrollment (K-12)" + f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 500
)
SELECT
  county,
  school,
  total_enrollment,
  free_meal_count,
  free_rate,
  frpm_count,
  frpm_rate,
  charter,
  num_test_takers,
  total_sat_score,
  num_ge1500,
  CASE
    WHEN frpm_rate >= 0.75 THEN 'High'
    WHEN frpm_rate >= 0.50 THEN 'Medium'
    ELSE 'Low'
  END AS frpm_level,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY county ORDER BY total_enrollment DESC) AS enrollment_rank,
  RANK() OVER (
    PARTITION BY county,
      CASE
        WHEN frpm_rate >= 0.75 THEN 'High'
        WHEN frpm_rate >= 0.50 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
      END
    ORDER BY total_sat_score DESC
  ) AS sat_rank
FROM base
WHERE frpm_rate > 0.60
   OR (num_test_takers > 0 AND CAST(num_ge1500 AS REAL) / num_test_takers > 0.30)

WITH sat AS (
  SELECT cds, sname, cname, dname,
         CAST(NumGE1500 AS REAL) / NumTstTakr AS excellence_rate
  FROM satscores
  WHERE NumTstTakr > 0
    AND CAST(NumGE1500 AS REAL) / NumTstTakr > 0.3
),
frpm_active AS (
  SELECT f.*,
         CAST(f."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" AS REAL) / f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS free_rate
  FROM frpm f
  JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
  WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
    AND f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 0
),
county_max AS (
  SELECT fa."County Name", MAX(fa.free_rate) AS max_rate
  FROM frpm_active fa
  JOIN sat ON sat.cds = fa.CDSCode
  GROUP BY fa."County Name"
)
SELECT fa."School Name",
       fa."County Name",
       fa."District Name",
       fa."School Type",
       fa."Educational Option Type",
       fa."Low Grade",
       fa."High Grade",
       fa."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)",
       fa."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)",
       fa.free_rate,
       sat.excellence_rate
FROM frpm_active fa
JOIN sat ON sat.cds = fa.CDSCode
JOIN county_max cm
  ON cm."County Name" = fa."County Name" AND cm.max_rate = fa.free_rate
ORDER BY fa."County Name"

sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    s.School AS school_name,
    s.District AS district_name,
    f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment_k12,
    f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" AS free_meal_count,
    f."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS frpm_count,
    f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS frpm_pct,
    CASE
      WHEN f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 0.75 THEN 'High Poverty'
      WHEN f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 0.50 THEN 'Medium-High Poverty'
      WHEN f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 0.25 THEN 'Medium-Low Poverty'
      ELSE 'Low Poverty'
    END AS poverty_level,
    sa.NumTstTakr AS num_test_takers,
    sa.AvgScrRead AS avg_score_reading,
    sa.AvgScrMath AS avg_score_math,
    sa.AvgScrWrite AS avg_score_writing,
    sa.NumGE1500 AS num_ge_1500,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY f."Enrollment (K-12)" DESC) AS enrollment_rank
  FROM schools s
  JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
  LEFT JOIN satscores sa ON sa.cds = s.CDSCode
  WHERE s.County = 'San Joaquin'
    AND s.Virtual = 'P'
    AND s.Charter = 1
)
SELECT
  school_name,
  district_name,
  enrollment_k12,
  free_meal_count,
  frpm_count,
  frpm_pct,
  poverty_level,
  num_test_takers,
  avg_score_reading,
  avg_score_math,
  avg_score_writing,
  num_ge_1500,
  enrollment_rank
FROM base
ORDER BY enrollment_rank

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    s.School AS school_name,
    s.County AS county,
    s.District AS district,
    s.OpenDate AS open_date,
    f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment_k12,

WITH district_stats AS (

         d.A3 AS region,

qualified_districts AS (

female_clients AS (

  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
),

)

WITH owners AS (
  SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, c.district_id, d.account_id

  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id

),

         SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS income,

  FROM trans
  GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT o.gender,
       CASE WHEN CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', o.birth_date) AS INTEGER) >= 1965 THEN 'Young'
            WHEN CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', o.birth_date) AS INTEGER) >= 1945 THEN 'Middle-aged'
            ELSE 'Senior' END AS age_group,
       ds.A3 AS region,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.client_id) AS num_owners,
       AVG(COALESCE(agg.income,0)) AS avg_income,
       AVG(COALESCE(agg.expense,0)) AS avg_expense
FROM owners o

JOIN district ds ON ds.district_id = o.district_id

sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date,
         a.account_id, a.frequency, a.date AS account_date,
         a.district_id
  FROM client c
  JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id AND dp.type = 'DISPONENT'
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
),
loan_stats AS (
  SELECT account_id,
         COUNT(loan_id) AS loan_count,
         SUM(amount) AS total_loan_amount,
         AVG(amount) AS avg_loan_amount,
         SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loans,
         SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_loans
  FROM loan GROUP BY account_id
),
trans_stats AS (
  SELECT account_id,
         COUNT(trans_id) AS trans_count,
         SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
         SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense,
         MIN(date) AS first_trans_date,
         MAX(date) AS last_trans_date
  FROM trans GROUP BY account_id
),
card_stats AS (
  SELECT dp.account_id,
         COUNT(cd.card_id) AS card_count,
         MAX(cd.type) AS card_type,
         MAX(cd.issued) AS card_issued
  FROM card cd JOIN disp dp ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id
  GROUP BY dp.account_id
)
SELECT b.client_id, b.gender, b.birth_date, b.account_id, b.frequency,
       b.account_date, b.district_id,
       COALESCE(ls.loan_count,0), COALESCE(ls.total_loan_amount,0),
       COALESCE(ls.avg_loan_amount,0), COALESCE(ls.active_loans,0),
       COALESCE(ls.completed_loans,0),
       COALESCE(ts.trans_count,0), COALESCE(ts.total_income,0),
       COALESCE(ts.total_expense,0), ts.first_trans_date, ts.last_trans_date,
       COALESCE(cs.card_count,0), cs.card_type, cs.card_issued,
       CASE WHEN COALESCE(ts.trans_count,0) >= 100 THEN 'High Activity'
            WHEN COALESCE(ts.trans_count,0) >= 30 THEN 'Medium Activity'
            ELSE 'Low Activity' END AS service_usage_category,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(ts.trans_count,0) DESC) AS trans_volume_rank
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN loan_stats ls ON ls.account_id = b.account_id
LEFT JOIN trans_stats ts ON ts.account_id = b.account_id
LEFT JOIN card_stats cs ON cs.account_id = b.account_id
ORDER BY COALESCE(ts.trans_count,0) DESC

         SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense,

q AS (

  FROM acct
)

WITH target AS (

client_info AS (

trans_hist AS (
  SELECT tr.account_id,
         COUNT(*) AS trans_count,
         SUM(CASE WHEN tr.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN tr.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense,
         SUM(CASE WHEN tr.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN tr.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,

  WHERE tr.date < t.loan_date

),
card_info AS (
  SELECT dp.account_id, COUNT(cd.card_id) AS card_count, MAX(cd.type) AS card_type
  FROM card cd

  GROUP BY dp.account_id
),
prev_loans AS (

WITH acct_loan AS (
  SELECT account_id, MAX(amount) AS max_loan
  FROM loan
  GROUP BY account_id
  HAVING MAX(amount) > 300000
),
nat_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(A11) AS avg_salary FROM district
),
acct_trans AS (
  SELECT account_id,
         SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
         SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense,
         COUNT(*) AS trans_count
  FROM trans
  GROUP BY account_id
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    a.account_id,
    a.district_id,
    d.A3 AS region,
    al.max_loan,
    COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count,
    SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount,
    AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount,
    c.client_id,
    c.gender,
    c.birth_date,
    COALESCE(t.total_income, 0) AS total_income,
    COALESCE(t.total_expense, 0) AS total_expense,
    COALESCE(t.trans_count, 0) AS trans_count,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(t.total_income, 0) > 1000000 THEN 'High Income'
      WHEN COALESCE(t.total_income, 0) > 500000 THEN 'Medium Income'
      ELSE 'Low Income'
    END AS income_classification,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(t.total_income, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
      ELSE (COALESCE(t.total_income, 0) - COALESCE(t.total_expense, 0)) * 1.0 / t.total_income
    END AS savings_ratio
  FROM acct_loan al
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = al.account_id
  JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
  JOIN disp dp ON dp.account_id = a.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
  JOIN client c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
  LEFT JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
  LEFT JOIN acct_trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
  WHERE d.A11 > (SELECT avg_salary FROM nat_avg)
  GROUP BY a.account_id
)
SELECT
  account_id,
  district_id,
  region,
  max_loan,
  loan_count,
  total_loan_amount,
  avg_loan_amount,
  client_id,
  gender,
  birth_date,
  total_income,
  total_expense,
  trans_count,
  income_classification,
  savings_ratio,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY max_loan DESC) AS region_rank
FROM base
WHERE (total_income - total_expense) > 0 OR trans_count = 0
ORDER BY max_loan DESC
LIMIT 100

       CAST(m.decin_accounts AS REAL) * 100 / m.total_accounts AS decin_pct,
       ts.avg_amount,
       ts.total_income,
       ts.total_expense,
       ts.trans_count,
       CASE
         WHEN CAST(m.decin_accounts AS REAL) * 100 / m.total_accounts > (SELECT yearly_pct FROM yearly) THEN 'above'
         WHEN CAST(m.decin_accounts AS REAL) * 100 / m.total_accounts < (SELECT yearly_pct FROM yearly) THEN 'below'

       END AS comparison
FROM monthly m

         d.A3 AS region,
         d.A11 AS avg_salary,
         d.A12 AS unemployment_1995,
         d.A13 AS unemployment_1996
  FROM account a
  JOIN disp dp ON dp.account_id = a.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
  JOIN client c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
  JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
  WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
),
ta AS (
  SELECT account_id,
         COUNT(*) AS trans_count,
         SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
         SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense,
         SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END)
           - SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_cash_flow,
         MIN(date) AS first_trans_date,
         MAX(date) AS last_trans_date
  FROM trans
  GROUP BY account_id
),
la AS (
  SELECT account_id,
         COUNT(*) AS loan_count,
         SUM(amount) AS total_loan_amount,
         AVG(amount) AS avg_loan_amount,
         SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loans,
         SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_loans
  FROM loan
  GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT b.account_id,
       b.client_id,
       b.gender,
       b.birth_date,
       b.age,
       b.district_name,
       b.region,
       b.avg_salary,
       b.unemployment_1995,
       b.unemployment_1996,
       COALESCE(t.trans_count, 0) AS trans_count,
       COALESCE(t.total_income, 0) AS total_income,
       COALESCE(t.total_expense, 0) AS total_expense,
       COALESCE(t.net_cash_flow, 0) AS net_cash_flow,
       t.first_trans_date,
       t.last_trans_date,
       COALESCE(l.loan_count, 0) AS loan_count,
       COALESCE(l.total_loan_amount, 0) AS total_loan_amount,
       COALESCE(l.avg_loan_amount, 0) AS avg_loan_amount,
       COALESCE(l.active_loans, 0) AS active_loans,
       COALESCE(l.completed_loans, 0) AS completed_loans,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(t.trans_count, 0) DESC) AS trans_volume_rank,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(t.net_cash_flow, 0) DESC) AS cash_flow_rank
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN ta t ON t.account_id = b.account_id
LEFT JOIN la l ON l.account_id = b.account_id
ORDER BY b.account_id

WITH client_age AS (
  SELECT c.client_id,
         CASE
           WHEN (CAST(STRFTIME('%Y','now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER)) < 30 THEN 'Young'
           WHEN (CAST(STRFTIME('%Y','now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER)) BETWEEN 30 AND 50 THEN 'Middle-aged'
           ELSE 'Senior'
         END AS age_group
  FROM client c
  JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
  WHERE c.gender = 'M' AND d.A3 = 'Prague'
),
acct AS (
  SELECT ca.age_group, dp.account_id
  FROM client_age ca
  JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = ca.client_id
),
loan_stats AS (
  SELECT a.age_group,
         COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count,
         SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans,
         SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_loans,
         SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount,
         AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount
  FROM acct a
  JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
  GROUP BY a.age_group
),
trans_stats AS (
  SELECT a.age_group,
         SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
         SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense,
         COUNT(t.trans_id) AS trans_count
  FROM acct a
  JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
  GROUP BY a.age_group
)
SELECT a.age_group,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS account_count,
       COALESCE(ls.loan_count, 0) AS loan_count,
       COALESCE(ls.good_loans, 0) AS good_loans,
       COALESCE(ls.bad_loans, 0) AS bad_loans,
       COALESCE(ls.total_loan_amount, 0) AS total_loan_amount,
       COALESCE(ls.avg_loan_amount, 0) AS avg_loan_amount,
       COALESCE(ts.total_income, 0) AS total_income,
       COALESCE(ts.total_expense, 0) AS total_expense,
       COALESCE(ts.trans_count, 0) AS trans_count
FROM acct a
LEFT JOIN loan_stats ls ON ls.age_group = a.age_group
LEFT JOIN trans_stats ts ON ts.age_group = a.age_group
GROUP BY a.age_group
ORDER BY CASE a.age_group WHEN 'Young' THEN 1 WHEN 'Middle-aged' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END

  SUM(ta.total_credit) AS total_credit,

  MAX(ta.max_balance) AS max_balance
FROM target tg

sql:
WITH bond_counts AS (
  SELECT bond_type, COUNT(bond_id) AS cnt
  FROM bond
  GROUP BY bond_type
),
most_common AS (
  SELECT bond_type FROM bond_counts ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1
),
mol_bonds AS (
  SELECT b.molecule_id, COUNT(b.bond_id) AS n
  FROM bond b
  WHERE b.bond_type = (SELECT bond_type FROM most_common)
  GROUP BY b.molecule_id
),
element_pairs AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a1.element || '-' || a2.element) AS pairs
  FROM connected c
  JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
  JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
  JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
  WHERE b.bond_type = (SELECT bond_type FROM most_common)
),
labels AS (
  SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT m.label) AS lbls
  FROM mol_bonds mb
  JOIN molecule m ON mb.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
)
SELECT
  (SELECT bond_type FROM most_common) AS bond_type,
  (SELECT cnt FROM bond_counts WHERE bond_type = (SELECT bond_type FROM most_common)) AS total_occurrences,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mol_bonds) AS molecule_count,
  (SELECT AVG(n) FROM mol_bonds) AS avg_bonds_per_molecule,
  (SELECT pairs FROM element_pairs) AS unique_element_pairs,
  (SELECT lbls FROM labels) AS molecule_labels

  JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = b.molecule_id || '_' || substr(b.bond_id, length(b.molecule_id) + 2 + instr(substr(b.bond_id, length(b.molecule_id) + 2), '_'), length(b.bond_id))

  JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = b.molecule_id || '_' || substr(b.bond_id, length(b.molecule_id) + 2 + instr(substr(b.bond_id, length(b.molecule_id) + 2), '_'), length(b.bond_id))
  WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
    AND (a1.element = 'c' OR a2.element = 'c')
  GROUP BY b.molecule_id
)
SELECT m.molecule_id,
       t.triple_bond_count,
       a.atom_count,
       b.bond_count,
       a.carbon_count,
       a.nitrogen_count,
       COALESCE(nn.nn_triple_count, 0) AS nn_triple_count,
       COALESCE(ct.c_triple_count, 0) AS c_triple_count

WITH h_counts AS (
  SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS h_count
  FROM atom
  WHERE element = 'h'
  GROUP BY molecule_id
),
label_h AS (
  SELECT m.label, SUM(h.h_count) AS total_h
  FROM molecule m
  JOIN h_counts h ON h.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  GROUP BY m.label
),
top_label AS (

  (SELECT AVG(h.h_count) FROM h_counts h JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = h.molecule_id WHERE m.label = (SELECT label FROM top_label)) AS avg_h_per_molecule,
  (SELECT AVG(bc) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS bc FROM bond b JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE m.label = (SELECT label FROM top_label) GROUP BY b.molecule_id)) AS avg_bonds_per_molecule,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond b JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE m.label = (SELECT label FROM top_label) AND b.bond_type = '-') AS total_single_bonds,
